{{PAGENAME}} are a craft-able crafting resource, requiring [[Faith]] and [[Oil]]. They are required in order to gain access to certain late-game writing and crafting recipes. They can also be processed at the [[study table]] to increase [[Science]], though given their relatively high cost - compared to bulk [[clean paper]] production, for example - it's generally not advised (but in mid to late game, you will likely not be hurting for any of the materials used in production of those).

Crafting a {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} produces {{Techpoint|Blue|2}}.
